WITH order_fee_stats AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as benchmark_rate
  FROM order_fee_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as avg_of_avg_rebates,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as avg_of_avg_net_fee_rates,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate) as avg_excess_over_benchmark
FROM order_fee_stats, benchmark
WHERE avg_net_fee_rate > benchmark_rate;
